input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 (Article 6, "Exclusivity") binds us, not HDI: it bars the Company from participating in any similar Internet project involving Deerskin Products or "products substantially similar" to them (an open-ended category expressly extended to "companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled"), and it gives HDI the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site. It fails the fallback on four of five elements: scope is not a single named competing product; there is no 12-month cap (Section 4.1 auto-renews the term for successive one-year periods, so the restriction can run indefinitely); and there is no carve-out for internal development or for acquisitions, the only carve-out (Section 6.2) being limited to closeout merchandise. The preferred position is also not met while HDI retains an exclusive right preventing us from using or licensing our own brand. We therefore take the preferred position and replace 6.1 with a clause-level no-restriction statement scoped to Section 6, so that the retained Section 9(b) Globix wind-down proviso, Section 6.2 (our closeout rights) and Section 6.3 (HDI's two-year covenant, which benefits us) all continue to operate without contradiction. Section 4.1 is cited for duration context only and is untouched.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.

proposal.summary: Replace the Section 6.1 Company exclusivity covenant (and HDI's exclusive Deerskin brand right) with a clause-level no-restriction statement
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict the products we sell or the Internet projects we run, so we have replaced Section 6.1 — which for the whole auto-renewing term barred the Company from any similar project involving Deerskin Products or "substantially similar" products and gave HDI the exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand — with an express statement that this exclusivity article imposes no such restriction. HDI's covenant in Section 6.3, the Company's retained closeout rights in Section 6.2 and the Section 9(b) Globix proviso are unaffected; if HDI needs protection we could discuss a 12-month restriction on a single named competing product with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
